name: Agni Green Power Ltd.
about:
Incorporated in 1995, Agni Green Power Ltd is 
 in the business of execution of turn-key Solar PV Power Plant projects. It provides EPC and O&M services to clients[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a registered channel partner of Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, Govt. of India, for off-grid solar PV applications. It is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and OH&S 45001:2018 certified company which specializes in providing complete turn-key solar PV power plant solutions from from design and engineering to installation, commissioning, and maintenance, for both standalone and grid-connected systems, ranging from just a few watts to several megawatts of capacity. It provides solar energy solutions using solar photovoltaic systems

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
